workflows.name: Share Register, Stock Ledger & Ownership / Cap-Table Administration

Automation Opportunity: - Cap-table automation; register-to-equity-account reconciliation; record-date automation; dilution modeling
Controls: - CTL-751 (ensure controlled execution — Shareholder Services, Equity Records, Dividend & IR Analytics (PA-173.3).)
- CTL-751: register/ledger legally maintained; reconciled to equity accounts (VS-17) & group (VS-72); record dates set; audited (VS-21)
Cross-references: - links to VS-36 (company secretary), VS-100 (legal), VS-17 (equity accounts), VS-72 (group/intercompany), VS-21 (audit), VS-102/W3324 (LTI/options), W5010 (ownership), W5020 (ASHM record date), W5023 (beneficial ownership), W5027 (dividend record date)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Register-error risk**: Inaccurate share register → invalid votes/dividends/ownership disputes; mitigated by reconciliation & controls
- **Dilution-blindness risk**: Untracked options/convertibles diluting cap table; mitigated by cap-table admin
- **Multi-entity-complexity risk**: 5-entity cap table inconsistencies (links VS-72); mitigated by group reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Share-register/cap-table system; equity accounts (VS-17); intercompany/group (VS-72); legal (VS-100); governance (VS-36); audit (VS-21); ownership intelligence (W5010)

steps.activity: Maintain the share register & stock ledger: the register of shareholders/members, stock ledger, issued/outstanding/treasury shares, classes/series, par value, and the cap table per entity (5 entities — links VS-72), ensuring legal integrity of ownership records (the ASHM/dividend/RPT foundation)

Administer the cap table & ownership: authorized vs issued vs outstanding, option/warrant/convertible tracking (links VS-102 W3324 LTI), dilution analysis, beneficial-owner mapping (W5023), and ownership intelligence feed (W5010)

Reconcile & assure: reconcile the register/ledger to the equity accounts (VS-17) and intercompany/group structure (VS-72), set record dates (links W5020 ASHM, W5027 dividend), and assure (VS-21); manage discrepancies as ownership-record risk

fields.Owner: Company Secretary (VS-36) / Transfer Agent / VP Investor Relations
fields.Participants: Legal (VS-100), Compliance (VS-22), Finance (VS-17), Transfer Agent, Audit (VS-21)
fields.Trigger: Share transfer/sale; gift/inheritance; pledge/lien; conversion/exercise; transaction (VS-130)

workflows.name: Stock Transfer, Share-Movement & Investor Position Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - Transfer-agent integration; register auto-update; reconciliation automation; lock-up/window enforcement
Controls: - CTL-751 (ensure controlled execution — Shareholder Services, Equity Records, Dividend & IR Analytics (PA-173.3).)
- CTL-751: transfers validated (restrictions/lock-up/insider-window W5022); register reconciled; encumbrances tracked; audited (VS-21)
Cross-references: - links to VS-36 (company secretary), VS-100 (legal), VS-21 (audit), W5022 (insider window), W5025 (register/cap table), W5010 (ownership), W5019/W5023 (threshold disclosure), VS-130 (transaction lock-up)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unauthorized-transfer risk**: Transfer breaching lock-up/restriction/insider window (W5022); mitigated by validation gates
- **Position-discrepancy risk**: Transfer-agent vs register mismatch; mitigated by reconciliation
- **Encumbrance risk**: Pledged/encumbered shares not tracked; mitigated by lien check
System Touchpoints: - Share-register/cap-table (W5025); transfer-agent platform; insider-trading-window (W5022); legal (VS-100); audit (VS-21); ownership intelligence (W5010)

steps.activity: Process stock transfers: instrument/endorsement validation, transfer-agent execution, register update (W5025), transfer restrictions/lock-up check (links VS-130, W5022 insider-trading-window), and pledge/lien/encumbrance check

Reconcile investor positions: registered vs street-name/beneficial, transfer-agent vs register, and reconciliation to the cap table (W5025) and ownership intelligence (W5010); manage splits/consolidations/conversions/exercises
Report & assure: share-movement reporting/filing (links VS-100, VS-166), audit trail (VS-21), and threshold-crossing disclosure where a transfer triggers it (W5019/W5023)

fields.Owner: VP Investor Relations / CFO / Treasury (VS-18) / Company Secretary (VS-36)
fields.Participants: Treasury (VS-18/W327 payment), Finance/R2R (VS-17), Company Secretary (VS-36 record date W5025), Legal (VS-100), Compliance (VS-22), Audit (VS-21)

workflows.name: Dividend & Distribution Program — Declaration-to-Payment, DRIP/Election & Unclaimed-Property

Automation Opportunity: - Dividend computation from register; DRIP platform; payment-file to treasury (W327); unclaimed-property tracking
Controls: - CTL-751 (ensure controlled execution — Shareholder Services, Equity Records, Dividend & IR Analytics (PA-173.3).)
- CTL-751: record date from register (W5025); entitlement computed; payment via treasury (W327); withholding tax applied (VS-79); unclaimed property handled; audited (VS-21)
Cross-references: - links to VS-18/W327 (treasury payment execution), VS-17 (dividend accounts), VS-36 (board declaration), VS-79 (withholding tax), VS-72 (cross-entity), VS-21 (audit), W5019 (declaration disclosure), W5025 (record date/register), W5031 (program analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-payment risk**: Wrong entitlement/record date → incorrect dividends (links W5025); mitigated by register reconciliation
- **Unclaimed-property risk**: Undistributed dividends unreported (regulatory); mitigated by escheatment process
- **Withholding-error risk**: Incorrect dividend withholding tax (VS-79); mitigated by tax-controls linkage
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/payment (VS-18/W327); equity/dividend accounts (VS-17); share register (W5025); tax (VS-79); legal (VS-100); audit (VS-21); intercompany (VS-72)

steps.activity: Run the dividend program (declaration→record date→payment): board declaration, disclosure (W5019), record date from the register (W5025), the dividend computation per shareholder/entitlement, and the payment instruction to treasury (links W327 in VS-18.1 which executes the cash payment)
steps.r: VP IR / Finance / Company Secretary / Treasury

steps.activity: Manage DRIP/election & alternatives: dividend-reinvestment (DRIP) election, scrip/cash election, cross-entity distribution handling (links VS-72), and the cap-table impact of reinvested shares (W5025)

Manage unclaimed property & reconciliation: undelivered/unclaimed dividends, escheatment/unclaimed-property compliance (links VS-79 tax, VS-166), dividend-to-ledger reconciliation (VS-17), withholding-tax handling (links VS-79), and audit (VS-21)

workflows.name: Shareholder Services, Investor Self-Service Portal & Inquiry Handling

Automation Opportunity: - Self-service portal; identity verification; document/issuance automation; SLA monitoring
Controls: - CTL-751 (ensure controlled execution — Shareholder Services, Equity Records, Dividend & IR Analytics (PA-173.3).)
- CTL-751: identity-verified access; privacy-compliant (VS-91); public-info-only (W5017); SLA-monitored; audited (VS-21)
Cross-references: - links to VS-36 (company secretary), VS-91 (privacy), VS-27 (IT), VS-21 (audit), W5015 (analyst inquiries), W5017 (disclosure), W5020 (ASHM/e-voting), W5025 (register), W5027 (dividend)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy/fraud risk**: Shareholder holdings/identity exposed or impersonated (RA 10173); mitigated by identity verification & privacy controls
- **Service-failure risk**: Unhandled shareholder request → complaint/regulatory issue; mitigated by SLA
- **Selective-disclosure risk**: Service channel leaking material info (W5017); mitigated by public-info-only standard
System Touchpoints: - Shareholder portal; share-register (W5025); dividend (W5027); tax (VS-79); ASHM/e-voting (W5020); privacy (VS-91); IT (VS-27); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Operate shareholder services: holdings/certificate/inquiry handling, address/bank-detail updates, lifecycle events (inheritance/transfer W5026, name change), document issuance, and the fair-disclosure-compliant response standard (W5017) — distinct from analyst inquiry handling (W5015)
steps.r: Company Secretary / Transfer Agent / VP IR

steps.activity: Run the investor self-service portal: secure shareholder access to holdings, dividend history (W5027), tax certificates (links VS-79), ASHM/proxy/e-voting (W5020), and forms — with RA 10173 privacy, identity verification, and records retention (VS-88)
Manage exceptions & assurance: service-SLA monitoring, complaint escalation, privacy/fraud controls, and audit of shareholder-services/portal operations (VS-21)

fields.Trigger: Analytics cycle; earnings; event/roadshow (W5012); rating/coverage change; activist signal

Automation Opportunity: - Sentiment/NLP on reports/social; ownership-flow analytics; feedback dashboards; activist-pattern detection
Controls: - CTL-751 (ensure controlled execution — Shareholder Services, Equity Records, Dividend & IR Analytics (PA-173.3).)
- CTL-751: sentiment/ownership measured periodically; insight fed to management (W5024); privacy-compliant (VS-91)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (analytics), VS-14 (media/social), VS-33 (strategy), W5010 (ownership), W5012/W5015 (feedback), W5013 (consensus), W5024 (feedback-to-management), W5030 (benchmarking), W5032 (activist)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Perception-blindness risk**: Management unaware of negative investor sentiment; mitigated by sentiment analytics & feedback (W5024)
- **Activist-blindness risk**: Ownership accumulation/activist undetected (W5032); mitigated by ownership-flow analytics
- **Survey-fatigue/privacy risk**: Over-surveying or mishandling investor data (RA 10173); mitigated by cadence & privacy
System Touchpoints: - Analytics/BI (VS-28); IR CRM (W5010); consensus (W5013); media/social monitoring (VS-14); strategy (VS-33)

steps.activity: Measure investor perception & sentiment: post-meeting/event feedback (W5012/W5015), analyst-report tone/sentiment, consensus vs guidance (W5013), media/social sentiment (links VS-14), and shareholder-survey insight
Analyze ownership & flow: ownership concentration/shift (W5010), retail vs institutional, turnover/flow, threshold crossings & activist signals (W5032), and rating/coverage trajectory (W5013)
Synthesize insight to management: integrate perception/sentiment/ownership insight into the board/management feedback (W5024), the IR plan (W5009), and the equity-story/narrative refresh (W5009)

fields.Trigger: Valuation review; rating/cost-of-capital analysis; transaction (VS-130); strategic-plan refresh (VS-33)
fields.Volume: ~8–12 companies in the peer set × metrics × quarterly cycles

Automation Opportunity: - Peer-data automation; multiple/benchmark dashboards; cost-of-capital modeling
Controls: - CTL-751 (ensure controlled execution — Shareholder Services, Equity Records, Dividend & IR Analytics (PA-173.3).)
- CTL-751: peer set rationale-documented; standardized metric framework; insight synthesized to narrative/decisions (W5009)
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-18/VS-170 (capital structure), VS-28 (analytics), W5009 (narrative/equity story), W5013 (rating), W5024 (board reporting)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Wrong-peer risk**: Inappropriate peer set distorting benchmarking; mitigated by peer-group rationale/review
- **Multiple-misuse risk**: Comparing non-comparable metrics; mitigated by standardized framework
- **Cost-of-capital-inaction risk**: Benchmarking insight not driving capital decisions; mitigated by synthesis-to-decisions
System Touchpoints: - FP&A/strategy (VS-33/VS-17.4); treasury/capital (VS-18/VS-170); analytics (VS-28); rating (W5013); equity story (W5009)

steps.activity: Build & maintain the peer set: comparable retailers/home-improvement/Philippine-conglomerate peers, the peer-group rationale, and the metric framework (revenue/margin/turns/growth, leverage, coverage, returns)

Benchmark valuation, multiples & capital structure: BuildRight vs peers on valuation multiples (P/E, EV/EBITDA-equivalent), capital structure & leverage (debt/equity, coverage — links VS-18/VS-170), cost of capital, and rating posture (W5013)

Synthesize to narrative & decisions: identify the valuation gap/narrative levers (W5009), feed cost-of-capital/capital-structure decisions (VS-18/VS-33), and the equity story (W5009) and board reporting (W5024)

fields.Trigger: Annual budget; quarterly review; IR-plan refresh (W5009); major event/transaction

workflows.name: IR Function Budget, Spend & Performance / ROI Management

Automation Opportunity: - Budget/spend tracking; vendor management; KPI/ROI dashboards
Controls: - CTL-751 (ensure controlled execution — Shareholder Services, Equity Records, Dividend & IR Analytics (PA-173.3).)
- CTL-751: budget planned & tracked; vendors TPRM-screened (VS-161); performance/ROI measured (W5029/W5030)
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (expense/procurement), VS-17 (finance), VS-161 (TPRM), W5009 (IR plan), W5012 (events), W5014/W5028 (platforms), W5029/W5030 (KPIs), W5024 (management reporting)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Budget-overrun risk**: Event/advisor spend exceeding budget; mitigated by spend tracking
- **Vendor-failure risk**: IR advisor/transfer-agent failure (links VS-161); mitigated by TPRM
- **Unmeasured-effectiveness risk**: IR spend without performance measurement; mitigated by KPIs/ROI

steps.activity: Plan the IR budget: the IR/people cost, advisor/banker/IR-vendor/consulting spend, event/roadshow cost (W5012), platform/portal cost (W5014/W5028), disclosure/filing fees (W5018/W5021), and analytics (W5029) — aligned to the IR plan (W5009)
Manage spend & vendors: IR-vendor/transfer-agent/advisor contracting & performance (links VS-34 procurement, VS-161 TPRM for vendor risk), spend tracking vs budget, and procurement-compliance (VS-34)

Measure performance & ROI: IR KPIs (coverage, sentiment W5029, valuation gap W5030, cost-of-capital impact), function effectiveness, and ROI of IR spend/events; feed to management (W5024) and the plan (W5009)

workflows.name: Crisis, Activist-Investor & Transaction IR Response Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - Activist/ownership-flow alerts; response-playbook workflow; crisis-comms/disclosure orchestration
Controls: - CTL-751 (ensure controlled execution — Shareholder Services, Equity Records, Dividend & IR Analytics (PA-173.3).)
- CTL-751: activist/ownership monitored (W5010/W5029); response playbooks maintained; disclosure-controls enforced (W5017/W5019); board-involved (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-130 (M&A), VS-36 (board/governance), VS-14 (crisis comms), VS-159 (security), VS-100 (legal), VS-18/W5013 (treasury/rating), W5010/W5029 (ownership/sentiment), W5017/W5019 (disclosure), W5020 (proxy/ASHM), W5021 (transaction disclosure), W5024 (lessons)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Activist-surprise risk**: Undetected activist accumulation (W5010/W5029); mitigated by ownership-flow monitoring & playbook
- **Disclosure-breach risk**: Activist/transaction leak disclosed selectively (W5017/RA 8799); mitigated by disclosure-controls
- **Response-unpreparedness risk**: No playbook → reactive/ineffective; mitigated by maintained playbooks
System Touchpoints: - Disclosure-controls (W5017); analytics (VS-28/W5029); M&A (VS-130); governance/board (VS-36); crisis comms (VS-14); legal (VS-100); treasury/rating (VS-18/W5013); corporate security (VS-159)

steps.activity: Detect & assess: activist-accumulation/ownership-flow signal (W5029/W5010), unsolicited approach, crisis triggering investor impact (W5019), or transaction (VS-130); convene the response team (IR, legal, strategy, comms, treasury, board VS-36)

Coordinate the IR response: the activist/defense playbook (engagement vs defense, board/shareholder communication, proxy defense links W5020), transaction IR (W5021), crisis investor-communications (W5019, fair-disclosure W5017), and rating/lender reassurance (W5013/VS-18)
Disclose, settle & learn: ensure all material aspects disclosed timely/fairly (W5017/W5019), post-incident review (W5024), and capture lessons in the IR/crisis playbook
